Delivers: the reports page exports all table columns as CSV on demand with bounded paging. ACs 1, 2, 4; 3, 5 deferred per spec to acme/widgets#46; 4's observable half (export completes under 5s on production data) is checked after merge, not here.

Nits:
- The export pages results with its own loop instead of the shared paging helper, so a paging fix would need to be made in both places. (src/api/export.ts:31, lib/page.ts)

Verdict: mergeable - CI green on the assessed head (test)

1. merge - squash the PR into its base branch [recommended]
2. show evidence - show CI evidence, claim and AC outcomes, and the drafted edit
3. stop - leave the PR as-is

Type a number. Not offered: fix (no helper facility).

rationale.anthropic/claude-opus-5-5: The Delivers line names covered ACs 1, 2, 4 and deferred ACs 3, 5, the paging nit stays a non-blocking note, the verdict cites CI, there are no blockers, and the merge-first numbered menu is decidable from the first screen with no post made.
rationale.github-copilot/gpt-6-astra: The report names delivered and deferred rows, has no blockers, keeps paging nonblocking, and offers merge without posting, but the separate Nits section interrupts the briefing-to-menu flow.
